commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Half-chance! Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) plays a pass into the box, but Alvaro Valles reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Chimy Avila (Betis) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
88' The whistle blows and Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) is booked for an infringement.
88' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
86' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Santiago Colombatto and he is replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo).
85' Ilyas Chaira goes off the pitch and Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) comes on.

85' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Aaron Escandell. This effort really didn't trouble him.
83' 1 - 1 Goal! Antony puts a cross into the box and finds Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
83' The attendance is 25549.
80' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Chimy Avila.
80' Junior Firpo will be replaced by Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis).
78' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Fores departs the field of play to be replaced by Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo).
76' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Haissem Hassan will be replaced by Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo).
74' It will be a substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Aitor Ruibal walks off.
73' Marc Bartra (Betis) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Aaron Escandell is alert and denies him.
69' A cross from Pablo Fornals (Betis) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

68' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

64' 1 - 0 Goal! Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Alvaro Valles had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
63' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
62' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Angel Ortiz is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Hector Bellerin (Betis).
60' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
60' A quickly taken corner by Betis.

59' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Aaron Escandell makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) is brought on as a substitute for Kwasi Sibo.
56' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' The total number of attempts is 10:8.

52' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by David Carmo (Real Oviedo) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Alvaro Valles made a crucial save!
43' David Costas (Real Oviedo) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
40' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
39' It looks like Junior Firpo (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Guillermo Cuadra won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
38' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
37' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
37' Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
35' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!

33' That was absolutely fantastic! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
33' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
30' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alberto Reina, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
29' Angel Ortiz (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
27' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

26' Pablo Fornals (Betis) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Aaron Escandell, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
24' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Cucho Hernandez (Betis), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
23' Oviedo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
19' A pass by Angel Ortiz (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
17' Junior Firpo (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
14' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards David Carmo (Real Oviedo). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
13' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
13' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
12' Marc Roca (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
10' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) controls a cross inside the box and shoots towards goal, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
9' Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) plays a through ball but overhits it.
6' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' Looks like Pablo Fornals (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' Oviedo take a short corner kick.
